{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module MessageConsumer where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Aeson (Value(..), object, (.=), decode, encode)
import qualified Data.Aeson as Aeson
import qualified Data.Aeson.Key as Key
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import Crypto.Cipher.AES (AES256)
import Crypto.Cipher.Types (cipherInit, cbcDecrypt, makeIV, IV)
import Crypto.Error (CryptoFailable(..))
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL

-- | Configuration for the message consumer
data ConsumerConfig = ConsumerConfig
  { encryptionKey :: BS.ByteString
  , queueName    :: Text
  , dbCollection :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Represents a message from the queue
data QueueMessage = QueueMessage
  { msgId      :: Text
  , msgPayload :: BS.ByteString  -- encrypted payload
  , msgHeaders :: [(Text, Text)]
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Decrypt the message payload using AES-256-CBC
decryptPayload :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Maybe BS.ByteString
decryptPayload key ciphertext
  | BS.length ciphertext < 16 = Nothing
  | otherwise = do
      let (ivBytes, encrypted) = BS.splitAt 16 ciphertext
      iv <- makeIV ivBytes :: Maybe (IV AES256)
      case cipherInit key of
        CryptoFailed _ -> Nothing
        CryptoPassed cipher -> Just $ cbcDecrypt cipher iv encrypted

-- | Strip PKCS7 padding from decrypted data
stripPadding :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
stripPadding bs
  | BS.null bs = bs
  | otherwise =
      let padLen = fromIntegral (BS.last bs)
      in if padLen > 0 && padLen <= 16
         then BS.take (BS.length bs - padLen) bs
         else bs

-- | Parse the decrypted JSON payload and extract query fields
parseMessageFields :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe Value
parseMessageFields raw = decode (BL.fromStrict raw)

-- | Sanitize a text value for safe use in queries
-- Removes MongoDB operator characters
sanitizeField :: Text -> Text
sanitizeField = T.filter (\c -> c /= '$' && c /= '.' && c /= '{' && c /= '}')

-- | Build a MongoDB query document from message content
-- This processes the decrypted message and constructs a lookup query
buildLookupQuery :: Value -> Text -> Value
buildLookupQuery (Object fields) collection =
  let -- Extract the routing key for the lookup
      routingKey = case HM.lookup (Key.fromText "routing_key") fields of
        Just (String rk) -> rk
        _                -> "default"
      -- Extract user-provided filter criteria
      filterDoc = case HM.lookup (Key.fromText "filter") fields of
        Just v  -> v
        Nothing -> object []
      -- Build the final query combining routing with filter
      query = object
        [ "collection" .= collection
        , "query" .= mergeFilter routingKey filterDoc
        ]
  in query
buildLookupQuery _ collection = object ["collection" .= collection, "query" .= object []]

-- | Merge routing key with user filter to build final query predicate
mergeFilter :: Text -> Value -> Value
mergeFilter routingKey (Object filterFields) =
  let sanitizedRouting = sanitizeField routingKey
      -- Construct base query with sanitized routing key
      baseQuery = HM.fromList
        [ (Key.fromText "routing_key", String sanitizedRouting)
        ]
      -- Merge user-provided filter fields into the query
      -- Each field value is passed through for flexible querying
      merged = HM.foldlWithKey' (\acc k v -> HM.insert k (transformFilterValue v) acc)
                                baseQuery
                                filterFields
  in Object merged
mergeFilter routingKey _ = object ["routing_key" .= sanitizeField routingKey]

-- | Transform filter values - handles nested query operators
-- This allows structured queries from trusted internal services
transformFilterValue :: Value -> Value
transformFilterValue (Object nested) = Object nested  -- pass through nested objects
transformFilterValue (String s) = String (sanitizeField s)
transformFilterValue other = other

-- | Process a single message from the queue
processMessage :: ConsumerConfig -> QueueMessage -> Maybe Value
processMessage config msg = do
  -- Step 1: Decode base64 payload
  rawCipher <- either (const Nothing) Just $ B64.decode (msgPayload msg)
  -- Step 2: Decrypt the payload
  decrypted <- decryptPayload (encryptionKey config) rawCipher
  -- Step 3: Strip padding
  let plaintext = stripPadding decrypted
  -- Step 4: Parse JSON from decrypted content
  fields <- parseMessageFields plaintext
  -- Step 5: Build the database query
  let query = buildLookupQuery fields (dbCollection config)
  return query

-- | Acknowledge message processing (stub)
ackMessage :: QueueMessage -> IO ()
ackMessage _ = return ()

-- | Main consumer loop entry point
consumeMessages :: ConsumerConfig -> [QueueMessage] -> IO [Value]
consumeMessages config msgs = do
  let results = map (processMessage config) msgs
  mapM_ (\(msg, _) -> ackMessage msg) (zip msgs results)
  return $ map (fromMaybe (object [])) results
